description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for authentication-related endpoints, including health check, signup, login, and password reset, with detailed inline documentation and Swagger annotations.

methods.name: router.get('/health')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /health endpoint, returning status of tenant salt configuration.

methods.name: router.post('/signup')
methods.description: Handles user signup, creating or updating user with hashed password, auto-generating tenant salt if needed.

methods.name: router.post('/login')
methods.description: Handles user login, verifying credentials, performing on-login migration from legacy hash to current scheme.

methods.name: router.post('/reset-password')
methods.description: Handles password reset, rehashing password with current scheme and updating user record.
